theater: 彭城與淮北（徐州至淮陰一線）

battle.name: 彭城之戰
battle.theater: 彭城與淮北（徐州至淮陰一線）
battle.brief: 公元466年，北魏天安元年與南朝宋泰始二年，淮北彭城一線再起兵端：魏軍沿泗淮水道南下試探，宋廷卻逢廣陵劉子勛之亂，抽走淮南兵馬，兩軍短兵相接後轉為遣使議和。卡面羅馬方陣盾未隨軍而至，但五世紀淮北的步戰同樣靠大盾列陣與騎兵衝鋒分勝負：宋軍以車陣強弩拒魏騎，魏軍用重甲鐵騎與長槊破陣。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 公元466年，淮北一線的兩個政權都站在北強南弱、僵持將盡的均勢末端。北方是北魏：天安元年正月拓跋宏即位為帝，尊馮太后為太皇太后，令其臨朝稱制，軍國大事仍循詔敕出行、尚書省奉行的舊例運作。魏軍在淮北的防區沿黃河、汴泗與淮水北岸展開，兵權分屬各州刺史與鎮軍將軍，邊鎮多置軍鎮戍兵，京畿另有宿衛宿騎，河西、朔方的馬政與弓箭供應則經郵驛連到前線；調兵的實際決策多由中書、尚書兩省擬詔，馮太后拍板，拓跋宏居於名義上的指揮位置。南面是劉宋：泰始二年在位的宋明帝劉駿以中軍、征西將軍與徐州刺史分掌淮南兵權，京口、廣陵一線留宿衛與州郡兵，荊州、益州方面的援軍要靠長江水運北上。彭城既是徐州治所，自太平真君七年（452年）起已入魏手，宋廷的實控線退到淮水南岸，下邳、淮陰、盱眙一帶成為前線要塞。同年十一月，廣陵太守劉子勛舉兵反宋，朝廷遣征西將軍侯安都率中軍北上平叛，淮南守兵大部被抽往廣陵，這便給了北魏在彭城一線試探的機會。兩邊的指揮系統都算不上精密：魏軍此番沒有專任南征大帥，多路兵馬各領一軍、各自為戰；宋軍則靠州郡守將與中央遣使互相牽制。整場衝突更像一場邊境試探與外交較量的合流，而不是一次決戰。
countriesEn: In 466 the two states facing each other along the Huai stood at the end of a lopsided stalemate in which the north was clearly the stronger. In the north was Northern Wei: in the first month of the Tian'an era (466) Emperor Tuohong took the throne, honoured Empress Dowager Feng as grand empress dowager and left her to govern from behind the curtain, while state business still ran through the old routine of edicts drafted by the Secretariat and carried out by the Department of State Affairs. Wei's garrison line in northern Huai followed the Yellow River, the Bian and Si waterways and the north bank of the Huai. Command was divided among provincial inspectors, regional generals and the commanders of frontier garrisons; the border towns each held their own garrison troops, the capital zone kept the imperial guard, and horses, bows and ammunition reached the front by the relay posts from the pastures and depots of Hexi and Shuofang. The practical decisions on troop movements were drafted by the Secretariat and the Department of State Affairs and approved by Empress Dowager Feng; Tuohong occupied the nominal place of commander-in-chief. In the south was the Liu Song court: in the second year of the Taiji era Emperor Ming of Song, Liu Jun, shared command of the southern bank among the Central Army, the Army of Conquest to the West and the Inspector of Xu Province, with the guard and the local militia of Jingkou and Guangling ready to move, while reinforcements from Jing and Yi provinces had to be floated up the Yangtze. Pengcheng, the seat of Xu Province, had already fallen to Wei in Tai'anqijun 7 (452), so the Song's effective line had retreated to the south bank of the Huai and Xiacan, Huaiyin and Xuyi became the forward positions. In the eleventh month of that same year Liu Zixun, governor of Guangling, rebelled against the Song; the court sent Hou Andao, Marquis of the West of the Conquest, north with the Central Army to put him down, and most of the Huai defence was dragged away to Guangling. That is precisely what gave Wei its opening to probe the Pengcheng line. Neither command system was particularly refined: Wei appointed no single commander for a southern campaign, and columns marched separately under separate leaders, while the Song relied on provincial commanders and envoys from the centre to check one another. The whole affair was therefore less a decisive battle than the meeting of a frontier probe and a diplomatic contest.
people: 彭城一線的推手，北魏一方是獻文帝拓跋宏與掌權的馮太后。拓跋宏天安元年正月即位，年紀尚輕，軍政實權握在馮太后手中；同年十月他暴崩，十一月其子拓跋濬即位，是為孝文帝，馮太后再度臨朝，把北魏推上改革的起點。真正決定彭城方向的是太后的一道命令：同意沿淮北的既有駐軍向宋境探出，而與宋的往來交給尚書省照舊例辦理，試探不成也不至於破裂。南宋方面的關鍵人物是宋明帝劉駿，他泰始二年在位，寵信近臣，對徐州、兗州一線的守將屢有更替，邊防空虛正是他用人失當的結果；同月廣陵的劉子勛起兵反宋、自立揚州刺史，牽制了淮南大軍，朝廷派征西將軍侯安都率中軍北上，途中分兵斷邗溝糧道、築壘逼近，劉子勛敗亡，這場內亂把北魏的注意力短暫吸引到淮南。還有兩位前輩值得並列：拓跋燾在452年、453年兩度南征，先取彭城、再下淮北，最後打到瓜步山才回軍，是這段邊界真正的開創者；宋方的臧質曾在453年之後收復下蔡、淮陰、盱眙，把被魏軍擠走的淮南防線一度拉回，檀道濟更是元嘉年間北伐的名將，但臧質在456年被誅、檀道濟在453年被冤殺，兩位北防名將都沒能留在466年的徐州一線。史書沒有留下彭城之戰雙方前線指揮官的可考姓名，記錄只到使節與州刺史一級，這是本役記錄殘缺的第一個原因。
peopleEn: The man behind the Pengcheng line on the northern side was Emperor Xiaowen Tuohong of Wei together with the Empress Dowager Feng who held the real power. Tuohong took the throne in the first month of the Tian'an era (466); he was still very young, and control of military and civil affairs rested in the hands of the dowager. He died suddenly in the tenth month of that year, and in the eleventh month his son Tuohong Jun succeeded him as Emperor Xiaowen, with the dowager once again governing from behind the throne, which set Northern Wei on the road to reform. What actually decided the direction of the Pengcheng front was one of her orders: the existing garrison in northern Huai was allowed to probe south of the border, while exchanges with the Song were left to the Department of State Affairs to handle by the old routine, so that if the probe failed nothing would be broken off. On the Song side the key figure was Emperor Ming of Song, Liu Jun, who reigned in the second year of the Taiji era. He favoured courtiers, repeatedly replaced the commanders of Xu and Yan provinces, and the hollow defence on that frontier was the direct result of his misuse of men. In the same month Liu Zixun, governor of Guangling, rebelled and proclaimed himself inspector of Yang province, tying down the Huai army; the court sent Hou Andao north with the Central Army, cutting the Hanggou supply road and building fortified approaches on the way, and Liu Zixun was destroyed. That rebellion drew Wei's attention briefly towards the south. Two predecessors deserve to be set beside them: Emperor Taiwu Tuohong campaigned south twice, in 452 and 453, taking Pengcheng first and the lower Huai afterwards, and only turned back after reaching Mount Guabu — he was the true founder of this frontier line; on the Song side Zang Zhi had retaken Xiacan, Huaiyin and Xuyi after 453, pulling the squeezed-back Huai defence out once more, and Tan Daoji was the famous northern expeditioner of the Yuanjia years, yet Zang Zhi was put to death in 456 and Tan Daoji was framed and killed in 453, so neither of the Song's masters of the northern defence was still there in 466. The transmitted histories preserve no verifiable names for the front-line commanders on either side; the record reaches only as far as envoys and provincial inspectors, which is the first reason why the documentation of this campaign is so thin.
kits: 本卡的兵器是羅馬方陣盾（Scutum），形制上源於公元前1世紀的羅馬軍團：凸面的長方大盾，靠盾緣彼此咬合成盾牆，盾手排成縱深，前列以盾承矢、次列接矛。必須說明，這件兵器並沒有出現在466年的淮北戰場上；中國南北朝的步戰盾是另一套東西——南朝宋軍常持大楯與牌，北魏軍則以圓盾護身、結大陣抵擋騎兵衝鋒，盾的形制、尺寸與防禦用法都與羅馬方陣盾不同。卡面盾的真正位置在血脈與原理層面：羅馬的盾牆傳承到五世紀的君士坦丁堡禁衛軍手中仍是主力，五世紀末的拜占庭重裝步兵仍在使用凸面長方盾；而同一時期的淮北，雙方的對壘方式也正是盾牆對騎兵，只是宋人把它做成車陣，以車為城、以弓弩交射，讓弓弩手躲在車後反覆齊射，把來襲的魏騎射散在陣前；魏軍則以重裝鐵騎成鋒、步兵繼之大楯結陣推進，用人馬的重量去撕開這種車盾防線。兵器上，宋軍的近戰骨幹是長柄槊、長矛與環首刀，遠程是弓、弩與大弩床子，車陣另配拒馬、鹿角；魏軍的骨幹是長槊、鐵鏃箭與馬刀，重騎裝備有鍪、鎧與馬具，糧秣以牛車自滑臺、睢州北運，人員與甲胄在幽州、冀州一線集結。攻城一方，北魏在前代攻彭城時曾堰睢水灌城，宋人則以撞車、雲梯、攻城樓應對。水陸運輸靠汴水、泗水、淮水與長江的船運，這條線在466年比任何一件兵器都更決定戰局。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman scutum, a form that comes from the legions of the first century BC: a large convex rectangular shield whose edges were locked against the edges of its neighbours to form a shield wall, the shield-holders drawn up in depth so that the front rank caught the arrows and the second rank brought the spears forward. It has to be said that this weapon did not stand on the battlefield of northern Huai in 466. The shields of the Chinese Southern and Northern Dynasties belonged to a different family altogether: the Song army commonly carried the big dap Shield and the pai, while the Wei army used round shields for protection and massed its formations to absorb cavalry charges, and in shape, size and manner of use those shields were nothing like the scutum. The true place of the card's shield lies in lineage and principle. The Roman shield wall passed down to the fifth-century imperial guard of Constantinople and was still the backbone of the Byzantine heavy infantry at the end of that century; and in the same period in northern Huai the two sides were indeed pitting shield wall against cavalry — only the Song had turned it into a wagon laager, making the wagons into a wall and crossing bow and crossbow fire so that the archers behind the wagons could shoot repeated salvos and break the charging Wei horsemen up in front of the line. The Wei answered with armoured heavy cavalry as the spearhead and infantry following in a massed formation of large shields, using the weight of men and horses to tear open that wagon-and-shield defence. As for weapons, the Song close-combat backbone was the long-shafted sou, the long spear and the ring-pommel sabre, with bows, crossbows and large traction crossbows for reach, while the wagon laager also carried caltrops and antler obstacles; the Wei backbone was the sou, iron-tanged arrows and the sabre, their heavy cavalry equipped with helmets, armour and harness, grain moving north in ox-carts from Huaiyin and Sui prefecture, while men and armour assembled on the Youzhou and Jizhou line. For siege work, Wei had flooded Pengcheng by damming the Si river in the earlier war, and the Song met sieges with battering rams, siege ladders and siege towers. Transport ran on the Bian, Si, Huai and Yangtze by boat, and in 466 that line of supply mattered more to the outcome than any single weapon.
tactics: 466年彭城一線的作戰，雙方都沿用南北朝以來的老套路。魏軍自北而南，出發點在黃河南岸的滑臺、陳留一帶，先以輕騎游騎越過睢、泗兩水，偵察宋軍在彭城、下邳、淮陰的部署，再以步騎分道：騎兵先鋒一日百里，步兵與大楯結陣在後，牛車夾行其間；遇宋軍車陣，即以長槊壓盾、以箭雨覆蓋車後的弓弩手，或直接以數百騎反覆衝撞車陣兩翼，待宋軍弓弩手箭盡，再驟然退開引誘追擊，然後回身掩殺。魏軍的掩護是壘城與塹壕，遇堅城則沿用前人辦法堰睢水以灌，砲車與雲梯配合，最後靠疲兵而取。行軍上，魏軍以騎兵遮蔽步兵的縱隊，撤退時仍以騎兵斷後。宋軍則完全反過來：以城、壘、津渡為依托，藉泗水與淮水的津渡設卡；兵少而靠裝備，車陣承襲劉宋對後秦車陣卻月陣一類的用法，把車輛橫排成弧，車後的弩手與步弓手交叉射擊，車與車之間以盾填補，專門對付魏軍的騎兵衝鋒；步兵在車陣兩翼持大楯與長槊，待魏騎力竭才出陣以長槊迎擊。補給線是兩軍成敗的另一個關鍵：魏軍糧秣由河北沿汴、泗水轉運，宋軍由建康、揚州經淮水、泗水北上，兩條線都依賴水運，一旦河道被封或渡口被斷，遠征的一方必須先退。彭城四野平曠、汴泗交流，正面雖有城池，卻極易被騎兵迂迴包抄，故守軍不敢離城深出，這也說明為什麼此條線上的勝負從來不靠一次會戰決定。
tacticsEn: The fighting on the Pengcheng line in 466 followed the old Northern and Southern Dynasties routines on both sides. The Wei army came from the north, starting from Huaiyin and Chenliu on the south bank of the Yellow River, first sending light and irregular horse across the Si and Sui to reconnoitre the Song deployment at Pengcheng, Xiacan and Huaiyin, and then splitting into foot and horse columns: the cavalry leading by a hundred li a day, the infantry following in a massed formation of large shields with the ox-carts travelling among them. Meeting a Song wagon laager, they pressed the sou against the shields, showered the archers behind the wagons with arrows, or simply battered the flanks of the laager with several hundred riders, then withdrew suddenly to draw a charge, and turned to kill in the confusion. Wei's cover in the field consisted of fortified camps and trenches; against a stubborn walled town the older expedient was used again, damming the Si to flood the walls, with stone-throwers and siege ladders cooperating until the defenders were worn out and the place taken. On the march the Wei cavalry screened the infantry columns, and on the retreat it was still the horse that covered the withdrawal. The Song fought the opposite way. They leaned on towns, camps and the crossings of the Si and Huai, blockading the fords; short of numbers, they relied on equipment, and their wagon laager carried on the tradition of the Song wagon formation known as the queyue formation used against Later Qin: the wagons were ranged in an arc, crossbowmen and archers behind them shot in crossed salvos, and the gaps between wagons were filled with shields, all of it aimed squarely at Wei cavalry. Their infantry stood on both flanks of the laiger with big shields and long sous, breaking out with the sou only when the Wei horse had spent itself. The supply line was the other key to the outcome: Wei grain came north China and moved by the Bian and Si, Song grain came from Jiankang and Yang province up the Huai and Si, and both depended on water transport, so that once a river was closed or a ford cut the side that had marched out had to fall back first. Pengcheng lay in open country at the meeting of the Bian and Si, and although it had walls on its front, it was easy for cavalry to swing round and envelop it, so the garrison dared not leave the city in depth. That is also why the outcome on this line was never decided by a single pitched battle.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但有幾個節點相當清楚。466年即天安元年，隋唐以前曆法所謂的正月，拓跋宏在平城即位；同年十月他暴崩，十一月拓跋濬即位；南面宋明帝的泰始二年與之同年，十一月劉子勛在廣陵舉兵，十二月中被平定。往前追，太平真君七年（452年）北魏攻取彭城，太平真君八年（453年）拓跋燾再南下，先取下蔡、淮陰，直抵瓜步山——瓜步在今江蘇六合瓜埠一帶，距離建康不過數十里，淮南與京口一帶縣邑被大掠，被擄的丁口以萬計，之後魏軍回師。太平真君十一年（456年）拓跋燾再至瓜步，淮南又一次震動。宋廷此後以臧質在453年後收復下蔡、淮陰、盱眙等處的成果為底，勉強維持淮南；臧質在456年被殺，泰山、彭城一帶的守備隨之削弱。兵力方面，拓跋燾南征時號稱眾數十萬，騎兵佔其大半；北魏從河北調兵，行程以千百里計，糧車往往跟在騎兵之後。宋廷能調集於淮南的兵卒以萬計，馬匹遠不如北方充足，弓弩與器械反而不弱。距離上，彭城至下邳約二百餘里水程，泗水自彭城東北流出，東南匯入淮水，全程數百里；彭城至建康則要順泗、淮兩水下行，約五百里以上。這些數字說明，466年一場邊境交鋒能吃掉的兵馬其實有限，消耗往往落在糧秣、牲畜與渡口的爭奪上。
dataEn: There are not many verifiable figures, but several fixed points stand out. The year 466 is the first year of the Tian'an era: in the first month, the month counted as such by the pre-Tang calendar, Tuohong took the throne at Pingcheng; in the tenth month of the same year he died suddenly, and in the eleventh month Tuohong Jun succeeded him. On the southern side the second year of the Taiji era runs in the same year; in the eleventh month Liu Zixun rose at Guangling and was put down in the middle of the twelfth. Looking further back: in Tai'anqijun 7 (452) Wei took Pengcheng, and in Tai'anqijun 8 (453) Taiwu Tuohong came south again, first taking Xiacan and Huaiyin and then driving straight to Mount Guabu — Guabu lies in the Guabu area of Liuhe in present-day Jiangsu, no more than a few dozen li from Jiankang, and the counties of the Huai and Jingkou regions were looted, with tens of thousands of people carried off, before the Wei army turned home. In Tai'anqijun 11 (456) Tuohong reached Guabu once more and the Huai region was shaken again. The Song afterwards built on Zang Zhi's recovery of Xiacan, Huaiyin and Xuyi after 453 and held the Huai shore as best it could; when Zang Zhi was killed in 456 the defence around Taishan and Pengcheng weakened with him. On numbers of men: when Taiwu campaigned south he claimed an army of tens of thousands, actually hundreds of thousands, and cavalry formed the larger part of it; Wei drew its troops from the north China plain, distances of a thousand li and more, with the grain wagons following behind the horse. The Song could gather tens of thousands of soldiers on the Huai side, far fewer horses than the north, but no lack of bows, crossbows and engines. As for distances, some two hundred li of water separate Pengcheng from Xiacan, the Si flowing out northeast of Pengcheng and joining the Huai to the southeast over a course of several hundred li; from Pengcheng to Jiankang means running down the Si and the Huai, five hundred li and more. These figures show that a frontier clash in 466 could only consume a limited number of men and horses, and that the real drain fell on grain, livestock and the contest for the crossings.
cause: 要理解466年彭城一線為何再起兵端，得把因由分成三層。最遠的一層是南北分立的根本：北魏統一北方之後，淮水一線就成兩國的邊界，南方政權要保住江南的財賦與人力，北魏則要消化河北與關中的編戶，雙方都明白統一是終局，因此邊境上每一次接觸都帶著終局試探的意味。第二層是前代留下的形勢：拓跋燾在452年奪下彭城、453年打到瓜步，淮北自此歸魏，宋廷退守淮南；此後十餘年間拓跋燾病死、皇位更迭，馮太后在466年之前的幾年裡幾次臨朝，北魏內部先後有宗室相殘與權力重組，無力再打一次瓜步式的遠征，邊界因而僵持。第三層才是直接導火：466年拓跋宏即位、馮太后重掌大權，同時江南發生劉子勛之亂，淮南精兵北上平叛，邊防一時空虛；魏軍原有的哨騎與追捕逃人的事件在泗、淮兩水一線時有衝突，宋廷又在此際更換徐州、兗州的守將，兩邊在彭城附近的接觸因此從巡騎摩擦升級為成建制交鋒。至於北魏此番是否真打算長驅直入，史料並無明言；較合理的推斷是馮太后以有限度的出兵，既試探宋廷虛實、也替新君立威，同時保留隨時退兵的餘地，這種試探與外交並行的處置方式正是此役的特色。
causeEn: To understand why the Pengcheng line flared up again in 466, the causes have to be taken in three layers. The farthest layer is the root of the northern and southern division: once Northern Wei had unified the north, the Huai became the frontier between the two states. The southern regime had to preserve the wealth and manpower of the Jiangnan, while Wei had to absorb the registered households of the Hebei plain and the Guanzhong basin. Both understood that unification was the eventual end, and so every contact on the frontier carried a hint of the trial that preceded it. The second layer is the situation left behind by the previous generation: after Taiwu took Pengcheng in 452 and reached Guabu in 453, northern Huai belonged to Wei and the Song court withdrew to the south of the Huai. In the dozen years that followed, Taiwu died, the throne changed hands, and the Empress Dowager Feng ruled as regime more than once before 466, while inside Wei there were successive clashes among the imperial clan and a rearrangement of power. Wei had no strength for another Guabu-style deep penetration, and the frontier therefore froze. Only the third layer is the immediate spark. In 466 Tuohong took the throne and the Empress Dowager Feng once more took the real power; at the same moment the Liu Zixun rebellion tore at Jiangnan, the picked troops of the Huai were pulled north to suppress it, and the frontier was briefly hollow. Patrol clashes and the business of chasing runaways along the Si and Huai grew into friction, and the Song court at that moment was replacing the commanders of Xu and Yan provinces, so that contact near Pengcheng escalated from the friction of patrols to clashes between formed bodies. As to whether Wei really intended to drive deep into the south, the histories say nothing; the more reasonable reading is that the Empress Dowager ordered a limited deployment, probing the Song defences and lending the new emperor some standing, while keeping the option of withdrawal at all times. That combination of probing and diplomacy is the real character of this campaign.
impact: 466年彭城一線的戰事沒有改變南北對峙的大格局，但它留下的幾樣東西對後世並不平凡。第一，短兵相接後轉為遣使議和的做法，確定了此後十三年的相安：北魏守淮北，宋守淮南，以淮水為大致分界，邊境維持低度摩擦而不再重演瓜步式的深入，這種不打大仗、也不完全絕盟的狀態一直延續到479年瓜步之役。第二，江南方面的教訓十分直接：劉子勛之亂與同時發生的邊境危機，讓宋廷意識到淮南與廣陵是同一條防線的兩端，此後的設防、屯田與水軍整頓都朝這個方向調整，揚州刺史的權責也隨之加重。第三，北魏內部的權力交接因這一役而加速：拓跋宏十月暴崩、拓跋濬十一月即位，馮太后再度攝政，此後的均田制、三長制與皇都南遷都發生在這一連串的邊界挫敗感之後，南北僵局最終逼出了深層改革的動機。第四，裝備與戰術的互相刺激最為具體：面對魏國重甲鐵騎，宋軍發展出以車為盾、以弩交叉直射的車陣戰法，弩的形制與張力不斷改良，射手與器械的配合成為南朝軍制的特色；魏軍在長期對壘中也把重騎的使用與大楯步兵的結合做得更細。第五，這條邊界最終還是靠更大規模的戰爭收場：479年北魏再攻瓜步，589年隋滅陳，南北分裂才真正結束，466年這樣的邊境試探只是長期僵持中的一環，但它把後來的走向提前擺上了桌面。
impactEn: The fighting on the Pengcheng line in 466 did not change the broad shape of the northern and southern stalemate, but several of its consequences mattered for what came later. First, the turn from hand-to-hand fighting to an exchange of envoys and a negotiated peace fixed thirteen years of quiet: Wei held northern Huai, the Song held the southern bank, the Huai itself served as a rough dividing line, and the border settled into low-level friction instead of another Guabu-style deep penetration, a state of neither great war nor complete severance that lasted until the Guabu campaign of 479. Second, the lesson for the south was direct. The Liu Zixun rebellion, coming at the same time as the frontier crisis, taught the Song court that the Huai and Guangling were two ends of the same line of defence, and the subsequent fortification, military farms and naval reorganisation were all adjusted accordingly, with the weight of the Inspector of Yang province increased to match. Third, the internal handover of power in Northern Wei was accelerated by this campaign: Tuohong died suddenly in the tenth month, Tuohong Jun took the throne in the eleventh, and the Empress Dowager Feng resumed the regency; the equal-field system, the three-length organisation and the later move of the capital came in the wake of this run of setbacks on the frontier, and the stalemate between north and south ultimately forced the motive for deep reform. Fourth, the most concrete result was the mutual stimulus given to equipment and method: facing Wei's armoured heavy horse, the Song developed the wagon laager, using the wagons as shields and crossing crossbow fire, and the shape and power of the crossbow were improved again and again until the pairing of shooter and engine became a hallmark of southern military organisation; Wei, over years of attrition, refined the use of heavy cavalry and its combination with infantry in large shields. Fifth, the line was eventually closed by far larger war: Wei attacked at Guabu again in 479, and in 589 the Sui destroyed the Chen, ending the division for good. A border probe such as the one of 466 was only one episode in a long frozen standoff, but it put the shape of what followed on the table early.
result: 結果是雙方都沒有拿到想要的東西。魏軍的推進止步於淮北，未能像452年至453年那樣深入淮南，也沒有取得瓜步那樣的戰果；宋軍守住了下邳、淮陰一線，卻沒有能力收復彭城，州郡與民眾在拉鋸中疲於奔命。戰事在短兵相接之後以議和收場：兩邊互派使節，商議歸還逃人與俘虜、劃定以淮水為界的防區，此後北魏退回淮北駐防，宋廷重新整合淮南的守備與屯田，中原與江南之間恢復了低度的邊市與往來，但使節往返的同時，兩軍也都在加固城壘、補充馬匹，準備下一個回合。人事上的結果更沉重：北魏方面，拓跋宏在同年十月暴崩、十一月拓跋濬即位，馮太后再度執政；南面，劉子勛之亂在年底平定，劉子勛本人敗亡，朝廷的注意力被迫由邊境轉回內部。必須坦白說，這場戰爭的記載在傳世史籍裡相當零碎：《魏書·顯祖紀》《宋書·明帝紀》與《資治通鑑》只以遣使、議和、破走等字句帶過，具體的交戰日期、雙方指揮官姓名、陣亡與俘虜數字都無可考，本文所寫的部署與戰法，是把452年攻彭城、453年與456年兩度南征瓜步的成案，與466年淮北的實際地形、後勤條件互相對照之後的推論，而不是某一份戰報的原文記載。
resultEn: In the end neither side got what it wanted. The Wei advance stopped in northern Huai, short of the deep penetration of 452 and 453 and short of any result comparable to Guabu; the Song held the line at Xiacan and Huaiyin but had no power to retake Pengcheng, and the commanderies and their people were worn down by the seesaw. The fighting ended in an exchange of envoys and a negotiated peace after the brief encounter: envoys went back and forth, discussing the return of runaways and prisoners and the fixing of a defensive zone along the Huai. Wei then withdrew to its garrisons north of the river, and the Song court rebuilt the garrisons and military farms of the Huai shore; between the central plain and the Jiangnan a low level of border trade and contact resumed, though while the envoys travelled the two armies went on thickening their walls and replenishing their horses for the next round. The outcome in personnel was heavier still. In the north, Tuohong died suddenly in the tenth month and Tuohong Jun took the throne in the eleventh, with the Empress Dowager Feng once more in power; in the south the Liu Zixun rebellion was settled at the year's end and Liu Zixun himself was destroyed, and the court's attention was forced away from the frontier and back inside the realm. It must be said plainly that the documentation of this war in the transmitted histories is thin. The Weishu, the Emperor Xiaowen record, the Songshu, the Emperor Ming record, and the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance carry it in a few phrases — envoys sent, peace discussed, the enemy driven off — and the exact dates of contact, the names of commanders and any figures for killed and captured simply are not recoverable. What is written here about deployment and method is an inference drawn by setting the recorded cases of 452, of the two Guabu campaigns of 453 and 456, against the actual terrain and the supply conditions of northern Huai in 466, and not a transcription of any single report.
